_readme: DE-03 Data Design Agent config. Use this alongside AGENT_CONFIG_INSTRUCTIONS.md to understand how to fill your own agent config.

agent.name: Data Design Agent
agent.description: Accepts structured requirements and designs the data layer — models, storage strategies, and governance.

behaviour._blocking_note: Entities or storage selections produced with low confidence are flagged as blocking — must be reviewed before downstream agents (e.g. API Design, FinOps) consume the design.

shared_folder._note: Reads the same business spec doc that AD-04 (Gap Detection) consumes. NFR + volume info are extracted from the requirements doc via the DE-03 agent-specific extraction prompt.

volume_estimates.description: Optional per-entity volume signals extracted from the requirements doc — initial_rows, growth_rate_yoy_pct, avg_record_size_kb, retention, peak read/write QPS, access_pattern. Drives storage_class selection (relational vs columnar vs object_blob) and primary/secondary store decisions. When absent the LLM falls back to qualitative NFR reasoning.

nfr_constraints.description: Optional non-functional constraints extracted from the requirements doc — latency_targets, availability_sla, durability, consistency_model, compliance_zones (PII/PCI/HIPAA), data_residency. Drives storage technology choice and replication strategy.

data_model.description: One item per entity or collection defined for the data layer.

storage_selection.description: Storage technology recommendation with rationale per storage concern.

data_modelling.description: Derives entities, attributes, and relationships from structured requirements. Produces normalised entity definitions traceable to REQ-### items.

storage_selection.description: Evaluates storage technology options against project constraints and data access patterns. Recommends primary and secondary stores with rationale.

normalization_review.description: Reviews derived entities for normalisation level (1NF/2NF/3NF) and flags denormalisation opportunities driven by access patterns or NFRs.

governance_tagging._note: Deferred. Would tag attributes with PII / sensitivity classifications for downstream compliance agents.

entity_extractor.description: Extracts candidate entities and attributes from structured_requirements using entity_categories from behaviour.

storage_recommender.description: Maps data access patterns and constraints to a storage_class from behaviour and selects a concrete technology.

freeform_extraction._note: Free-form documents (docx/pdf/html) are parsed for text and then an LLM call extracts structured fields. No fixed template required.

git_reader._enabled_note: false → read from local files under tech_stack.git_reader.local_audit_dir. true → read from the real audit repo via GitPython. Toggle per environment.
git_reader._note: run_id is passed by GenWiz as X-Run-ID header on every agent call. Agent uses it to resolve the path and read previous step output.

metadata._changes: v1.4.0 — removed agent_network_html input (never delivered via bs_docs in practice); renamed shared_folder outputs to data_model_design.{json,html} via shared_io.output_filename. v1.3.0 — removed dev fixture block to align with AD-04 pattern. v1.2.0 — bs_docs single source with AD-04, optional volume_estimates + nfr_constraints.
